extraction.Name: Stephen Murray
extraction.Buyer: Mortgage executed by Murray for a consideration of $2600; conveyed land to Charles M. Ritts December 5, 1923, for $1321, due February 20, 1924, by Murray and wife
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612700 issued; North half of Section 26, township 42, north of range 33; patent receipted for by the allottee February 4, 1918; mortgage dated November 20, 1923, subject to the mortgage; deed by Murray and wife to Charles M. Ritts
